map.整体结论怎么判？: How is the overall verdict judged?
map.平均环比 ≥5% 判为整体上行，≤−5% 判为整体下行，介于两者之间为基本平稳；: An average change of ≥5% counts as an overall uptrend, ≤−5% as an overall downtrend, and anything in between as basically flat; inverse metrics are best read separately.
map.上期为 0 怎么办？: What if the previous period is 0?
map.环比需要除以上期值，上期为 0 的行会被跳过，请补填真实上期数据或改用其他口径。: The change divides by the previous period value, so rows with a previous value of 0 are skipped; fill in real previous-period data or switch to another definition.
